title: ClusterAudienceKit Squid audienceSegmentMembership record v1
description: One custom-object membership record. customerId is an opaque CRM/customer reference; names, emails and other PII must not be copied here.

id.description: Existing Squid record id, added only after a membershipId lookup match.

membershipId.description: Stable identity derived from segmentId + customerId.

customerId.description: Opaque customer/CRM identifier. Never an email, phone or name.

score.description: Optional model/segment score for this membership.
